topic: Decide between two internet providers for the flat

scenario.topic: Decide between two internet providers for the flat
scenario.opening_question: Which internet provider gives us the best balance of speed, reliability, and cost for our flat?

options.name: FiberHome 300 Mbps Unlimited Plan
options.upside: High-speed fiber connection with unlimited data
options.concern: Installation fee upfront might be a hurdle
options.best_for: Users prioritizing fast, reliable internet for work and streaming

options.name: CableNet 250 Mbps No-Contract Plan
options.upside: No contract and no installation fee for flexibility
options.tradeoff: Slightly slower speeds compared to fiber
options.concern: Potentially less reliable during peak hours
options.best_for: Users valuing flexibility and lower upfront costs

options.name: UltraConnect 500 Mbps Premium Plan
options.upside: Very high speeds ideal for heavy streaming and gaming
options.tradeoff: Highest monthly cost and long contract duration
options.concern: Long contract limits switching options if service is poor
options.best_for: Users needing top-tier speed and can commit long-term

options.name: MetroLink 150 Mbps Budget Plan
options.upside: Lowest monthly cost with decent speeds for basic use
options.tradeoff: Lower speed may struggle with multiple simultaneous users
options.concern: May not fully support heavy remote work or streaming needs
options.best_for: Users prioritizing cost savings over top speed

shared_context: We are two people sharing one flat
Our monthly internet budget is capped at $60
We need a stable connection for remote work and streaming

personas.name: Wyatt
personas.background: Wyatt works from home and needs a reliable, high-speed internet connection to support video calls and streaming.
personas.private_goal: He prefers a fast and stable connection even if it requires a contract and some upfront cost.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.name: Isla
personas.background: Isla enjoys gaming and streaming with the highest possible speeds and is comfortable committing to a longer contract for premium service.
personas.private_goal: She values top-tier speed and is willing to pay more and commit longer to ensure the best internet performance.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
